name: pipeline-relay
description: File-based trigger for Antigravity chats. Create a trigger file in .relay/ → dispatch its contents as a prompt.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Pipeline Relay reads .relay files from the workspace and sends their contents as prompts. Trust the workspace before enabling relay dispatch.

pipelineRelay.startPaused.description: Start paused on activation. When true, you need to click the status bar button to begin watching. Prevents stale files from previous sessions from auto-dispatching.

pipelineRelay.afterNewChatDelay.description: Delay (ms) after creating a new chat before sending the prompt.

pipelineRelay.afterSendDelay.description: Delay (ms) after sending the prompt before processing the next trigger.

pipelineRelay.writeJsonLog.description: Write JSONL dispatch events, including full prompt contents, to .relay/.logs/relay.jsonl. Disable to avoid storing prompts on disk.
